resources.description: URL to clean JSON for AI agents. Fetches any public web page server-side and returns title, meta description, canonical URL, a heading outline, and boilerplate-stripped plain text — navigation, sidebars, cookie banners and footers removed. Saves an agent from running its own fetch + HTML-parsing + readability stack. Flat $0.01 per call, no account, no API key, no rate limit.
